comment: Reviewed classification of every Trimble API definition outside the Trimble-Connect SwaggerHub organisation. scripts/fetch-trimble-other-specs.py discovers definitions by crawling every developer.trimble.com product section's sitemap for pages that embed an OpenAPI viewer (spec-url), plus the direct sources listed below. cmd/trimble-catalog fails if a discovered definition matches no rule.

safety.reason: safety: sends a work order or prescription (application map) to the in-cab device of a vehicle, which can drive field machinery; the bridge never plans or performs anything that reaches machinery
safety: changes GNSS receiver, antenna, correction or position-stream settings on a field device; positioning that guides survey or machine work must be configured by a qualified person on the device

rules.note: Trimble Connect definition; catalogued from the Trimble-Connect SwaggerHub organisation

rules.reason: placeholder example served from a personal GitHub Pages site (noel-tw.github.io); not a Trimble API

rules.auth: Trimble Identity bearer token in the Authorization header
rules.access: Customer; the user needs the 'API Data Access' permission
rules.requires: Accubid Anywhere entitlement, a Trimble Identity token with API Data Access, and the service host (the definitions give only a relative server)

rules.auth: not declared in the definition (401 responses are defined); Trimble Identity per the product docs
rules.requires: a Civil Site Management subscription and credentials accepted by https://cloud.api.trimble.com/site-management/v1
a Trimble Identity token with the field configuration service scope
a Trimble Identity token with the jobs service scope

rules.auth: none declared; the API is served locally on the field device
rules.requires: running on the device that hosts Trimble Mobile Manager (https://tmm-api-local.fieldsystems.trimble.com:9638 or http://localhost:9637)

rules.auth: OAuth 2.0 via Trimble Identity (authorization code or client credentials)
rules.requires: a ProjectSight subscription, a Trimble Identity application scoped for ProjectSight, and the API host (not stated in the definition)

rules.auth: HTTP basic or OAuth 2.0 password grant
rules.access: Licensed; requires the Integration Toolkit module
rules.requires: a TMT tenant host (single-tenant or on-premises) and Integration Toolkit credentials

rules.auth: OAuth 2.0 client credentials from Trimble Transportation identity (cloud.api.trimblecloud.com)
rules.access: Licensed customer via Trimble Transportation Cloud
rules.requires: TMWSuite licence, Transportation Cloud client credentials, and the customer's connector host

rules.auth: HTTP bearer (Trimble Identity JWT, TruckMate web user, or API key)
rules.requires: TruckMate REST licence, a bearer credential, and the customer's TruckMate host
an e-Builder / Unity Construct account and API credentials; regional hosts api2.e-builder.net, api2-us2/us3/us4, api2.ca, gov-api2
a Unity Maintain / Permit (Cityworks) tenant host (https://{unityMpHost}/services) and a bearer token for it

rules.product: Trimble Construction One: Vista (App Xchange Direct API)
rules.access: Cloud-hosted Vista customers who purchase the Vista API; 2,000 requests per minute per key
rules.requires: a Vista API application key and subscriber code for api.xchange.trimble.com or api-ap-au.xchange.trimble.com

rules.auth: API key in the Authorization header
not declared in the definition; see the developer guide
rules.access: PTx Trimble developer programme (agdeveloper.trimble.com now redirects to ptxag.com)

rules.note: Endpoints from the OpenID Connect discovery document. The bridge's own sign-in (internal/identity, trimblectl auth) uses authorize, token and revoke; agents never call Identity endpoints because they carry credentials.

rules.reason: publicly reachable but not linked from any Trimble documentation; undocumented endpoints are not used (safety rule: no private or undocumented endpoints)
publicly reachable (beta) but not linked from any Trimble documentation; undocumented endpoints are not used
development support-ticket API in the Tekla SwaggerHub organisation ('tsupport-v3-dev'); not linked from Tekla documentation
